content_sections.body: Work without notes first. For the situation 'reviewing arrangements', say one sentence that meets this goal: Review offers, invitations, arrangements, and changes. content_sections.body: Before the unit test, check three things: the main message is clear, one useful detail is included, and the listener knows what happens next. Say or write a new short message about a similar situation, not the model about reviewing arrangements.
